subject: dragonfly
title: The Insect That Catches Up to 95% of Its Prey. Here's How

scenes.text: The best hunter in the sky is an insect smaller than your finger.
Most predators miss far more than they hit. A dragonfly catches up to 95 percent of what it chases.
Its secret isn't speed. It's where it flies.
It tilts its body to stay below the target, right in the prey's blind spot.
Then special neurons in its brain predict where the prey will be next, even inside a swarm.
The prey never sees it coming. And the dragonfly almost never misses.

description:
The best hunter in the sky is an insect smaller than your finger.
A dragonfly catches up to 95 percent of the prey it chases by staying in the blind spot and predicting where its target will go.
Would you have guessed an insect beats lions and sharks at hunting? Tell us below.
